{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module CryptoAudit (
  verifyAndLog,
  AuditEntry(..),
  CryptoContext(..)
) where

import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as C8
import Data.ByteString (ByteString)
import qualified Crypto.Hash as H
import Database.SQLite.Simple
import Database.SQLite.Simple.ToField
import Data.Time.Clock (getCurrentTime)
import Data.IORef
import Control.Exception (bracket, SomeException, try)
import Data.Word (Word8)
import Data.Bits (xor, (.|.))
import qualified Data.ByteString.Base16 as B16

data AuditEntry = AuditEntry
  { aeOperation :: String
  , aeKeyFingerprint :: String
  , aeStatus :: String
  , aeMetadata :: String
  } deriving (Show)

data CryptoContext = CryptoContext
  { ctxDbConn :: Connection
  , ctxKeyStore :: IORef [(String, ByteString)]
  , ctxAuditLevel :: Int
  }

-- | Compute SHA-256 fingerprint of a key
keyFingerprint :: ByteString -> String
keyFingerprint key = C8.unpack $ B16.encode digest
  where
    digest = H.hashWith H.SHA256 key

-- | Constant-time comparison of two ByteStrings to avoid timing side channels.
-- Comparison time depends only on the length of the inputs, not on where
-- the first differing byte occurs.
constantTimeEq :: ByteString -> ByteString -> Bool
constantTimeEq a b
  | BS.length a /= BS.length b = False
  | otherwise = BS.foldr (\w acc -> acc) True a `seq` (accumulated == 0)
  where
    accumulated :: Word8
    accumulated = BS.foldl' (.|.) 0 (BS.pack (BS.zipWith xor a b))

-- | Normalize operation names for consistent audit trail
normalizeOp :: String -> String
normalizeOp op = map sanitizeChar op
  where
    sanitizeChar c
      | c `elem` ['a'..'z'] = c
      | c `elem` ['A'..'Z'] = c
      | c `elem` ['0'..'9'] = c
      | c == '_' = c
      | c == '-' = c
      | otherwise = '_'

-- | Format metadata for storage - handles encoding of special fields
formatMetadata :: [(String, String)] -> String
formatMetadata pairs = concatMap fmtPair pairs
  where
    fmtPair (k, v) = k ++ "=" ++ v ++ ";"

-- | Internal: write audit record using fully parameterized query
-- All fields including fingerprint use parameter binding to prevent
-- any possibility of injection regardless of input source.
writeAuditRecord :: Connection -> AuditEntry -> IO ()
writeAuditRecord conn entry = do
  let baseQuery = "INSERT INTO audit_log (operation, key_fingerprint, status, metadata, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, datetime('now'))"
  execute conn (Query $ C8.pack baseQuery)
    (aeOperation entry, aeKeyFingerprint entry, aeStatus entry, aeMetadata entry)

-- | Verify a signature and log the operation
verifyAndLog :: CryptoContext -> String -> ByteString -> ByteString -> ByteString -> IO Bool
verifyAndLog ctx opName key message signature = do
  let fp = keyFingerprint key
  let expectedSig = H.hashWith H.SHA256 (BS.append key message)
  -- Use a constant-time comparison to avoid leaking information about the
  -- signature via timing side channels.
  let isValid = constantTimeEq (B16.encode expectedSig) signature
  let status = if isValid then "SUCCESS" else "FAILURE"
  let normalizedOp = normalizeOp opName
  let metadata = formatMetadata [("msg_len", show $ BS.length message),
                                  ("sig_len", show $ BS.length signature)]
  let entry = AuditEntry
        { aeOperation = normalizedOp
        , aeKeyFingerprint = fp
        , aeStatus = status
        , aeMetadata = metadata
        }
  when (ctxAuditLevel ctx > 0) $
    writeAuditRecord (ctxDbConn ctx) entry
  return isValid
  where
    when True action = action >> return ()
    when False _ = return ()

-- | Register a key with a label for later lookup
registerKey :: CryptoContext -> String -> ByteString -> IO String
registerKey ctx label key = do
  let fp = keyFingerprint key
  modifyIORef (ctxKeyStore ctx) ((label, key):)
  let entry = AuditEntry
        { aeOperation = "register_key"
        , aeKeyFingerprint = fp
        , aeStatus = "SUCCESS"
        , aeMetadata = formatMetadata [("label", label)]
        }
  writeAuditRecord (ctxDbConn ctx) entry
  return fp

-- | Lookup operations by fingerprint for audit review
queryAuditByFingerprint :: CryptoContext -> String -> IO [String]
queryAuditByFingerprint ctx fp = do
  results <- query (ctxDbConn ctx)
    "SELECT operation FROM audit_log WHERE key_fingerprint = ?"
    (Only fp)
  return $ map fromOnly results

initSchema :: Connection -> IO ()
initSchema conn = execute_ conn
  "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audit_log (\
  \  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\
  \  operation TEXT NOT NULL,\
  \  key_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,\
  \  status TEXT NOT NULL,\
  \  metadata TEXT,\
  \  created_at TEXT NOT NULL)"
